info.title: Karelia returned media resources
info.description: Companion to openapi.json. Resource-oriented HTTP, not catalogue JSON. HLS playback/seek was observed in Chrome and bounded 64 KiB Range probes verified transport. Media URLs may change. The original encoded path needs a pass-through transport.

tags.name: Media
tags.description: Returned HLS, MP4 and original-file URLs

get.description: Captured VOD playlist version 3, target duration 10 seconds, relative MPEG-TS segment references. No encryption key or separate audio playlist appeared in this sample; do not assume that for every title.

parameters.name: bucket
parameters.description: Opaque bucket component from returned URL.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: Optional byte range, e.g. bytes=0-65535. Keep bounded probes small; no full video download is needed to validate metadata.

200.description: Resource bytes; inspect Content-Type and Content-Range.

Content-Length.description: Size of this returned range, not necessarily the whole asset.

Content-Disposition.description: Original downloads can provide UTF-8 filename*.

Access-Control-Allow-Origin.description: Observed * on the tested HLS playlist and segment; not returned by the tested original file.

206.description: Resource bytes; inspect Content-Type and Content-Range.

Content-Length.description: Size of this returned range, not necessarily the whole asset.

Content-Disposition.description: Original downloads can provide UTF-8 filename*.

Access-Control-Allow-Origin.description: Observed * on the tested HLS playlist and segment; not returned by the tested original file.

403.description: Access denied; directly observed for the /dav alternative. Do not treat a returned URL as proof of anonymous availability.

get.x-returned-url-policy: Use the complete URL returned by filelist. Do not guess bucket, asset, host or encoding.

get.description: This operation uses fsN servers. Same file ID can have original and converted download variants; select by returned URL.

parameters.name: encodedPath
parameters.description: Already percent-encoded opaque legacy path, potentially containing encoded slashes and non-UTF-8 bytes. Preserve it exactly. A generator's normal UTF-8 encoding can double-encode it; use ENCODE_PATH: value => value for already encoded returned paths, or fetch the returned full URL directly.
